value: Go into detail! Write down all your thoughts so that we can better understand your idea. What do you want to implement and where?
Gehe ins Detail! Schreibe alle Gedanken auf, die du dir gemacht hast, damit wir deine Idee besser verstehen können. Was möchtest du wo umsetzen?

We would like to be able to contact you if we have any questions or to let you know that your idea has made it to the next round!
